row: On this channel we will share videos documenting the Belize Wildlife and Referral Clinic - BWRC, a non-profit wildlife rescue and teaching clinic in Belize. The BWRC's vision is Wildlife conservation and sustainable development in cooperation. The BWRC plays a small but diverse role in it's mission to support conservation with veterinary services, rehabilitation and education. Videos will cover topics in Wildlife medicine and conservation education, introduce some special patients cases and stories as well as common wildlife conflict species or victims of wildlife traffic. We hope to tell our patients stories to educate humans how to avoid conflict and how to best assist wildlife in need.
